children: Bangladesh plans to commission a new floating storage and regasification unit to import liquefied natural gas in Moheshkhali Island in Cox's Bazar district by 2028, a minister said on Friday.

The country is also planning to develop a land-based import terminal at Matarbari by 2030, said Anindya Islam Amit, state minister for power, energy and mineral resources, at the LNG Producer-Consumer Conference in Tokyo on Friday.
